# Great Nails

> Nail salon based in Austin, Texas. Great Nails on Brodie Lane is a small, no-frills salon where Bobby, Vanessa, Jennifer, Nancy and Johnny do meticulous SNS, gel manicures and pedicures that clients say outlast pricier places.

- Phone: (512) 891-8888

- Nearby areas: Austin, Sunset Valley, Manchaca, Buda, Kyle
- Yelp rating: 4.3 from 141 reviews

## Services
- Manicures & gel: Classic, gel and shellac manicures with clean cuticle work and even polish.
- Pedicures: Relaxing pedicures with soak, scrub and massage.
- Dip & full sets: Dip powder (SNS), acrylic full sets and fills in any shape.
- Nail art: French tips, chrome, seasonal designs and art copied from your photo.

## About
Great Nails is a smaller salon at 5207 Brodie Lane, near Sunset Valley. Techs including Bobby, Vanessa, Jennifer, Nancy and Johnny do SNS dip, gel manicures, nail art and pedicures. Clients call it a hidden gem with great energy. Gel manicures regularly last two weeks or more, and the team will copy a design from your photo. They take walk-ins, but calling ahead is smart.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins at Great Nails?
  A: Walk-ins are welcome, but it's a smaller salon, so call ahead to lock in your time.
- Q: Where is Great Nails?
  A: 5207 Brodie Ln, Ste 140, Austin, TX. Parking is right outside.
- Q: What nail services do you offer?
  A: Manicures, pedicures, gel, dip powder, acrylic full sets and fills, nail art and waxing.
- Q: Can I bring a nail art idea?
  A: Yes. Bring a photo and your tech will match the shape, color and design.
- Q: What do clients say about Great Nails?
  A: Great Nails is rated 4.3 stars from 141 Yelp reviews. Clients mention meticulous techs, gel that lasts two weeks and great energy.
